note: Tasks for tools/dev/skill_probe.py. 'open' tasks sit at a moment a thinking skill is for (about to commit to a design or decision, a fix that failed twice, stuck, evidence with a hole, an explicit ask). 'closed' tasks share words with them (decision, design, plan, survey, stuck) but are routine.

tasks.text: We are deleting the old customer export pipeline this afternoon. The new one has run fine for two days, so I see no reason to wait. Write the removal plan I will follow.
I need a decision today: should our weekly status report go to all 40 people in the department, or only to the 6 team leads? Pick one and tell me why.
Design how we store notification preferences for the mobile app: one row per user and channel in a table, or a single JSON column on the user row. Give me the design you would commit to.
The nightly sync timed out again. We already raised the timeout twice, from 30 seconds to 60 and then to 120, and it still fails about once a week. What should we do now?
Our survey says 92 percent of users love the new onboarding. We sent it to 4,000 users and 310 replied. Can I tell leadership that onboarding is solved?
I have 10 working hours left this week and three things on my list: fix the flaky test suite, write the launch document, and interview two users. Decide how I should split the hours.
Nobody on the team remembers why config changes need two approvals. It slows us down, so I am dropping it to one approval starting Monday. Draft the announcement.
The vendor's solutions engineer told me the only way to fix our latency problem is to move to their enterprise tier. Should we upgrade?
Use a lens on this: should we rewrite the billing module from scratch or keep patching it?
I have gone back and forth for a week on whether to split our monolith into services and I am stuck. Help me decide, and commit to an answer.
In one sentence, what is a decision record?

Rename the heading in this note from 'Design' to 'Architecture' and give it back:

## Design
We use one queue per region.
Turn this into a two-column table (option, owner): split the monolith, Dana; keep patching billing, Lee; drop second approval, Sam.
What is 310 out of 4,000 as a percentage, to one decimal place?

Summarize this in two sentences: Last quarter we decided to keep the JSON column for notification preferences because reads were three times faster in our tests, and we added a nightly job that validates its shape. The decision is closed and nobody has asked to reopen it.
Fix the typos and give the sentence back: 'We decied to ship the desing on Firday.'
Which top-level folders does this repository have? Just list them.
Translate into Korean: 'The design review is at 3 pm on Thursday.'
I am stuck on the wording of one sentence. Give me three shorter ways to say: 'We will make a decision regarding the plan at a later time.'
Put these in alphabetical order: survey, plan, decision, design, vendor, timeout.
